# openloops

> A TypeScript runtime for AI agents that run in your backend. It persists chats, tasks and tool calls in MongoDB, scopes everything to a user, asks for approval before destructive tools and unapproved MCP servers, and can run agents on a schedule. It has no HTTP layer: your backend calls its use cases and owns authorization.

Start with the integration guide, then read only the pages you need. All pages are in this folder.

## Start here

- [Integration guide](integration-guide.md): what to write in a backend, which endpoint calls what, and the security checklist
- [README](../README.md): what it is, the quick start and the package structure

- [Configuration](configuration.md): environment variables, default model, timeouts

- [Building an AgentLoop](loops.md): AgiLoop, the loop contract, RunContext and Harness
